gate_reason: FAIL. The worktree was valid: detached HEAD is exactly 90004d7, and refs/heads and origin for sprint/r-3b-compose-and-workspace-tests both point to it. Two Blocking findings stand. (1) The sprint `requirements` list omits REQ-SAG-0703 and REQ-SAG-0803, crate-level ids for crates the sprint owns (REQ-QA-001). (2) The REQ-SAG-0135 'pass in CI' criterion is not verifiable, because remote CI has not run (REQ-QA-002). Code and doc compliance is otherwise strong: all named deliverables, tests, manifests, ADR flips and release inputs were found and traced, and no PayloadBuilder or sc-observability use remains in sc-ai or sc-jev-py. Three Minor drift items are listed (REQ-QA-004 to 006). The crate rename and the owner decisions were not raised as findings. I read the code but ran no cargo, pytest, maturin or CI command; the developer's validation log is self-reported and was not independently re-run. Finding id REQ-QA-003 is unused.
